description: This file defines a Java interface 'RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand' that extends several other interfaces related to live command behavior, including the retrieval of feature properties within the context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It serves as an entry point for creating command answer builders and provides accessors for feature IDs.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand
classes.description: A Java interface representing a live command to retrieve feature properties, capable of creating answer builders and accessing feature identifiers.

methods.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor for the interface (implicitly, as interfaces do not have constructors). The interface extends other interfaces to define its capabilities.
